title: Q-Guard has a new project manager! Welcome Victor!
excerpt: We are delighted to welcome Victor SIMAS to Q-leap as leader of Q-Guard development. With almost 16 years’ experience in the software industry, and his previous role as a solutions architect, he brings a wealth of expertise and a commitment to quality.
description: Victor Simas joins Q-Leap as project manager for Q-Guard, bringing nearly 16 years as a developer and architect to our test automation software.
